88:t_020:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's save the touching reunion for later! First, we take down $$バルビエル$$!」

88:t_020:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「What's with that? That's awfully serious for you, Old Man $$ランド$$!」

88:t_020:14.en:
$$恵子$$
「And on top of that, the $$ガンレオン$$ is in Magna Mode right from the start...」

88:t_020:15.en:
$$メール$$
「That's because Darling's burning rage is setting the $$ガンレオン$$ ablaze.」

88:t_020:16.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Could it be the power of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$ $$スフィア$$?」

88:t_020:18.en:
$$ランド$$
「While I'm at it, that $$バルビエル$$ guy's $$スフィア$$ power is stronger than mine or $$セツコ$$'s.」

88:t_020:20.en:
$n
「The $$傷だらけの獅子$$ and the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...」

88:t_021:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「You there, kid! Can you fight?!」

88:t_021:1.en:
$n
「I'm fine! Thank you for the repairs!」

88:t_021:4.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain! We have a transmission from a Resistance group!」

88:t_021:5.en:
$$ラム$$
「They've broken through the interception units around here and will reach this area in three minutes!」

88:t_021:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, you heard the report! In three minutes, the Resistance will be here to help us!」

88:t_021:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Be very careful of the enemy $$スフィア・リアクター$$! He's forming a special field around himself!」

88:t_021:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「So that's what they call a $$スフィア・アクト$$...!」

88:t_021:9.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It seems that power differs from Reactor to Reactor!」

88:t_021:10.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If we hold out for three minutes, we'll have the advantage in numbers too! Hang in there until then!」

88:t_021:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I don't like a single one of you...」

88:t_021:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「Feeling's mutual. I haven't forgotten what you did.」

88:t_021:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「A second-rate Reactor...! I'll teach you your place!」

88:t_021:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I will fight people who trample on others' lives like that!」

88:t_021:15.en:
$$ランド$$
「Get ready, $$バルビエル$$! I've waited a hundred years for this...! Time to pay you back!!」

88:t_022:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Is this all you've got?」

88:t_022:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「A $$烙印$$ bearer and a second-rate Reactor... What a waste of treasure.」

88:t_022:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You bastard!!」

88:t_022:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$傷だらけの獅子$$... No matter how much you roar, you can't beat me.」

88:t_023:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Three minutes have passed. It's about time.」

88:t_023:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「A $$烙印$$ bearer and a second-rate Reactor... What a waste of treasure.」

88:t_023:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You bastard!!」

88:t_023:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$傷だらけの獅子$$... No matter how much you roar, you can't beat me.」

88:t_024:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...You want this base that badly?」

88:t_024:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then you can have it.」

88:t_025:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Losing it because he knows he's beaten, huh!」

88:t_025:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I don't need this base anymore. As I thought, there are limits on this Earth...」

88:t_025:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You would understand what that means, wouldn't you, $$ターンタイプ$$?」

88:t_025:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He's... looking at the $$ホワイトドール$$...!?」

88:t_026:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「$$バルビエル$$, preparations are complete.」

88:t_026:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's been a while, $$ランド$$. But unfortunately, we don't even have time for tea.」

88:t_026:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「We have to go to the $$蒼の地球$$ now, you see.」

88:t_026:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I told you. There are limits on this Earth.」

88:t_026:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The land of this planet was eroded long ago... by poison.」

88:t_026:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then let us be off, $$バルビエル$$. ...Though there is an obstacle in our path.」

88:t_027:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're an eyesore, you small fry...!」

88:t_028:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let's go, $$サルディアス$$.」

88:t_029:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「B-but...! We did achieve the objective of the operation for now, didn't we!」

88:t_029:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Can this... be called a victory...」

88:t_029:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

88:t_029:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「He said he was going to the $$蒼の地球$$.」

88:t_029:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then we're going too! We'll pay back this debt on their Earth!」

88:t_029:9.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That person... seemed to know something about the $$ホワイトドール$$...」

88:t_029:10.en:
$$メール$$
「Don't let it get to you, $$ロラン$$. Getting under people's skin like that is that guy's hobby.」

88:t_029:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Do you guys know that guy, $$ランド$$?」

88:t_029:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「You could say that... I owe that bastard a huge debt.」

uncertain: 88:t_021:15: ここで会ったが百年目 rendered as 'I've waited a hundred years for this' (idiom: found you at last, you're done for).
88:t_025:6: ホワイトドールを…見ている…!? rendered 'He's looking at the White Doll' (Barbiel as subject; could be 'watching/eyeing').

Barbiel/Sardias 様 dropped per no-honorific rule (Sardias reads less servile); ターンタイプ, 傷だらけの獅子, 烙印 used as tokens with plain 'bearer' suffix.
88:t_021:7: 奴 = 'He' (Barbiel, enemy Reactor); 傷だらけの獅子のスフィア rendered '$$傷だらけの獅子$$ $$スフィア$$'.
